summary: Verified iter-155 Demand Forecast bug fix (../utils → ../../utils). App compiles cleanly (only pre-existing eslint warnings). Full end-to-end admin flow works on NAV Busy tenant with real data (13,696 SKUs). Admin-only guard (403) confirmed at API level for all 4 forecast endpoints when hit as salesman.
critical_code_review_comments: DemandForecast.js line 53 useEffect has missing 'load' dep (ESLint warning). Not blocking but should either include load in deps or wrap load in useCallback to avoid stale-closure edge cases when growth/horizon/festival change rapidly.
Cosmetic-only: browser console shows a hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from AppNavbar line 83 (FY selector). Pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL app is a SPA that uses state-based routing (no react-router paths). To reach Analytics, first login via header 'Login' button, then click 'Analytics' in top nav. Direct URL like /analytics is meaningless. Login also works via POST /api/auth/login and seeding localStorage['flowra_token'] followed by page.reload().
